{"path": "/results/10_feb_melting/claude_45/tool_calling/surface_energy/task/level_1/brief/aluminum_surface_energy_1_trial_3/calculate_surface_energy.py", "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Calculate surface energy from LAMMPS simulations
"""

# Read the CIF file to get the unit cell dimensions
from pymatgen.core import Structure

# Load structure
structure = Structure.from_file("al_structure.cif")

# Get lattice parameters
a, b, c = structure.lattice.abc
alpha, beta, gamma = structure.lattice.angles

print(f"Unit cell dimensions: a={a:.6f}, b={b:.6f}, c={c:.6f} Angstrom")
print(f"Unit cell angles: alpha={alpha:.2f}, beta={beta:.2f}, gamma={gamma:.2f} degrees")

# Calculate the surface area after replication (5x5x5)
# For [0,0,1] surface, the area is in the x-y plane
lx = a * 5  # replicated 5 times in x
ly = b * 5  # replicated 5 times in y

# For FCC aluminum, the structure is cubic, so a=b=c
surface_area = lx * ly  # in Angstrom^2

print(f"\nReplicated box dimensions (5x5x5):")
print(f"Lx = {lx:.6f} Angstrom")
print(f"Ly = {ly:.6f} Angstrom")
print(f"Surface area (x-y plane) = {surface_area:.6f} Angstrom^2")

# Energy values from simulations
E_bulk = -1679.86275358002  # eV
E_surface = -1631.81097242534  # eV

# Energy difference
delta_E = E_surface - E_bulk
print(f"\nEnergy difference (E_surface - E_bulk) = {delta_E:.6f} eV")

# Surface energy calculation
# We have 2 surfaces (top and bottom) when we remove periodicity in z
num_surfaces = 2
surface_energy = delta_E / (num_surfaces * surface_area)

print(f"\nNumber of surfaces created: {num_surfaces}")
print(f"Surface energy = {surface_energy:.6f} eV/Angstrom^2")
print(f"Surface energy = {surface_energy:.10f} eV/Angstrom^2")

# Also convert to J/m^2 for reference
# 1 eV/Angstrom^2 = 16.0217662 J/m^2
surface_energy_Jm2 = surface_energy * 16.0217662
print(f"Surface energy = {surface_energy_Jm2:.6f} J/m^2")
"}
